newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint closes down vs dlr, up on basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint closes down vs dlr, up on basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly lower against the dollar on Thursday but strengthened against a basket of currencies the national bank uses as the basis of its intervention band, traders said.

The forint finished at 159.90/95, down slightly from Wednesday's close of 159.65/70. But the Hungarian unit was trading within 15 to 20 pips of the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level, narrowing the gap from 40 pips on Wednesday.
"We could see foreign investors who thought those levels were convenient for them to sell dollars for forints and buy Hungarian t-bills," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
Dollar futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) mostly dropped, the mark was unchanged and other major currencies were steady. December ecu dropped.
Foreign currency futures trade in a single session in the morning, on the BCE.
